title: Tax IDs (Go kit)
summary: Indonesian tax identities: the 16-digit NPWP (old 15-digit ones normalized with a leading 0), the NIK as an individual's NPWP (length, region, birth date), the 22-digit NITKU of a place of business, passport numbers, an unofficial NPWP check digit as a warning, and masking for display. Formats only — registration is DJP's to confirm.
when_to_use: A module stores or checks an NPWP, NIK, NITKU, or passport number — customers, suppliers, employees, the company profile.
when_not_to_use: Confirming that a number is registered or that a party is a PKP — only Coretax/DJP can.
Tax calculations (PPN, PPh) — a tax module's.
